additionalPlain:
Lever builds modern recruiting software for teams to source, interview, and hire top talent. Our team strives to set a new bar for enterprise software with modern, well-designed, real-time apps. We participated in Y Combinator in summer 2012, and since then have raised $73 million. As the applicant tracking system of choice for Netflix, Eventbrite, ClearSlide, change.org, and thousands more leading companies, Lever means you hire the best by hiring together.

Lever is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out! We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives. Learn more about our team culture and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

description: We are looking for a talented and motivated Senior C++ Developer to join our Integration & Software Releases team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable end-to-end systems. You will collaborate closely with product managers, architects and other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

lists.text: What will your job look like
lists.content:
• Design, Develop and maintain scalable and high-performance end-to-end systems.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver new features.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices.

  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing systems.

• B.Sc/BA in Computer Engineering or Computer Science - must.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Developer - must.

  • Experience in C++ programming language - must.

  • Low-level SW development and debugging experience.

  • Experience in Linux OS.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Strong verbal skills in English.

• Experience with Python programming language.
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).

descriptionBody: We are looking for a talented and motivated Senior C++ Developer to join our Integration & Software Releases team. You will collaborate closely with product managers, architects and other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
